source.fit_validation_policy: Deterministic whole-story 90/10 split from en-10k training member; official test is label-sealed and never used for model selection.

fit_subphases.query_counts: Computed from actual story assignments in each run manifest; never assumed from story fractions.
fit_subphases.ordering: Stable hash assignment, then preserve source order within each phase; online events are consumed in story-local order.

partitions.validation: Read-only; no parameter, threshold, normalization or candidate update is permitted.

task_level_contract.L0: Grounding/feature prediction: task-specific mention, temporal-anchor or directed-edge observations.
task_level_contract.L1: Relational prediction: coreference binding, temporal precedence or ordered spatial/path composition.
task_level_contract.L2: Context prediction: entity-state, temporal-context or route-context state.
task_level_contract.answer: Separate task-query answer target at L2; exact answer scoring is not substituted for L0/L1/L2 target scoring.

channel_routing.temporal: L0 feature prediction and SOE temporal eligibility/credit
channel_routing.relational: L1 typed relation and path/coreference/temporal-relation learning

task_level_contract.gold_separation: GoldLabel and official support-line IDs are evaluator-only. They are never passed to runtime ingestion, feature construction, warm start or online adaptation.

oracle_upper_bounds.policy: Report separately as diagnostic upper bounds; exclude from candidate selection and non-oracle baseline threshold.

experimental_design.run_order: Stable lexicographic task, architecture, condition, seed order before sharding.
experimental_design.pairing: HLA and HLB use identical task story order, seed, phase assignment, feature projection, query order and forecast horizons.
experimental_design.reset: Every run unit starts from a clean model/native runtime; no state crosses seeds, conditions, tasks or architectures.

ablation_semantics.no_temporal: Disable temporal eligibility/credit and L0 feature-predictor updates only.
ablation_semantics.no_abstraction: Disable L2 context and event-role abstraction updates only.
ablation_semantics.no_learning: Disable every learning update; preserve inference, evidence, predictions and scoring.

candidate_selection.candidates: full_learning only; ablations remain comparative conditions
candidate_selection.ranking: Highest validation answer exact-match, then highest witness recall, then lowest seed as deterministic tie-break.
candidate_selection.failure: If no seed passes every task-specific acceptance gate, no confirmatory candidate is selected.

experimental_design.confirmatory: A generated, label-separated challenge is a later phase. Its generator, seeds, novel entity/topology rules and hashes must be frozen separately after validation candidate selection. Official test members remain sealed.

metrics.aggregation: Report every task, architecture, condition and seed separately. Story-clustered paired bootstrap with 10,000 resamples and 95% intervals. No pooled cross-task score or ranking.

performance.answer_exact_match: At least the strongest non-oracle baseline on the same validation queries.
performance.selection: All integrity and performance gates must pass per task/architecture/seed; otherwise candidate is not eligible.

workload.story_calculation: 120 run units per task × (2,000 Task 11 stories + 2,000 Task 14 stories + 10,000 Task 19 stories).
workload.baselines: Six non-oracle baseline evaluations plus three separately reported oracle upper-bound evaluations, one set per task.
workload.estimate_policy: No wall-clock or memory estimate is fabricated. Before authorization, measure a representative non-learning runtime preflight, verify actual event counts and capacity, then publish projected wall-clock, peak-memory and artifact-storage budgets.

sharding.assignment: Enumerate the frozen 360-unit manifest in stable order; assign unit index modulo 4 to shard 0..3.
sharding.isolation: Each shard writes only to its own run-id/shard-id evidence directory; aggregate only after all four shards finish.
sharding.retry: Retry only failed shard/unit keys; successful unit artifacts are immutable and reused by exact key and digest.
sharding.evidence_directory: Create before starting any run unit. Upload shard evidence with always() semantics, including failures; report explicit empty-run diagnostics instead of silently omitting evidence.
sharding.aggregate_gate: All 360 unique run-unit keys must be present exactly once; no duplicate, missing or mixed-manifest unit is accepted.

artifacts.provenance: Every artifact binds task, architecture, condition, seed, partition fingerprint, code commit, native runtime commit and protocol fingerprint.

required_before_launch: Runtime/prediction-contract PR merged and CI green on Python 3.10 and 3.12.
Task-specific baseline implementations and validation metrics reviewed.
Four-shard dry-run proves complete artifact creation, retry isolation and deterministic aggregation.
Measured workload, memory and storage budget reviewed.
Generated confirmatory challenge protocol separately frozen.
Explicit user authorization to launch the 360-unit learning campaign.
execution_gate.freeze_boundary: This protocol freeze authorizes implementation and preflight only. It does not authorize any learning run, validation campaign, confirmatory campaign or access to official test labels.
